honest.text:
Dear [k.duarte's Name],

Thank you for reaching out regarding the recent changes to Fairmont Library's hours. I understand your concern about the loss of evening availability.

During the recent county budget cycle, adjustments were made to branch hours across the system. Unfortunately, Fairmont Library's hours were reduced from 56 to 39 per week, impacting evening and Sunday service. We understand this is disruptive, especially for those who rely on the library after work or on weekends.

The library director actually recommended a different branch for cuts, but the final decision was part of the overall budget process. To help mitigate the impact, we've added Saturday morning hours at Fairmont starting in October and are introducing a new bookmobile that will visit the branch every other week.

Please don't hesitate to contact our office at dist3-office@ridgeline-county.gov or [phone number] if you have further questions or concerns.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
Constituent Services Assistant
Office of Supervisor Dana Reyes
